The third file is outside the claim's named surface — accepted: it is the human-facing twin of the paste line's pinned shape (the tool's own docblock names it), and leaving it would have recreated the requirement / tool divergence this card exists to close; no open PR touches it. One landing on SKILL.md since the claim: PR #18921 (`37ca54a11`, hunks :162–:183) — disjoint from :339; PR #18903 (:509–:525, :633–:675) and PR #18981 (:363–:371, queued) likewise.
- **The corpus half.** A ruling comment is recognised by the SHAPE of its first content line — `Ruling: …` (the charter line in `director.md`), `## Ruling recorded — …` (the pre-charter director shape; the incident's own 5651572469 is written in it), `Ruling addendum …` — measured over 1,100 live comments in two windows; two near-miss shapes measured and pinned OUT (`**Ruling C landing step**`, `## Ruling A's … is falsified`), listed uncounted so a spelling drift shows as a near-miss rather than an empty thread. The dispatch's fallback (an author predicate on `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) was falsified by measurement — the director seat wrote as three logins in five days and that predicate would have missed 5651572469 itself; the quoted-「同意」 predicate names nothing (63 of 500 comments quote one). Correct readings, and the falsification is the seat's own hypothesis, as invited.
- **The read.** One paged `GET …/issues/{n}/comments?per_page=100&page=P` walked by page number to a short page (never `Link:`, per `rest-channel.md`), bounded at `MAX_THREAD_PAGES = 50` (a filled bound is `unresolved`, never a clean read of its first pages), reconciled against the card's own `comments` count (a mismatch is flagged as 「one landed between the two reads; re-run」 — the #18052 transient), no retry on any status, and the cost metered off the wire: #17518 1 page / 141,623 B / ~0.35 s; #12708 4 pages / 2.2 MB / 2.0 s; #6015 (the longest thread) 10 pages / 7.4 MB / 4.4 s — the fixed cost the triage asked to be measured, measured. Read BEFORE the tree corpora, so an exit 3 still means 「nothing was searched」.
- **The line.** `Prior rulings read: … ; thread: k ruling(s) (ids)` / `thread: none` (read, empty) / `thread: not read (no --card)` (a `--terms`-only run, which stays offline) — three spellings kept apart, and an unreadable thread makes the WHOLE line `unresolved` at exit 3, exactly as an unreadable corpus does. The report adds, when a ruling already stands, the SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉③ sentence (the card is execution, cite the ruling on `Ruling-ref:`) and, for two or more, 「a conflict goes back to the director seat, not to a dev as a choice」. :339 now reads 「方向在 ADR/本卡裁决/不可重裁规则:…」; :45 pins the clause. Requirement and tool change in one batch — the triage's condition, met.
- **Seat re-measure on the head** (scratch worktree at `cba9319955`): `--self-test` 144 cases (main 99), the live-tree D8 pin `pinned`; ratchet ✓ 812 / 812 and 50 / 50; `check-skill-id-lint` ✓ 27 files; the live reader test `PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectstack node scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 17518` at 12:00Z: exit 0, `thread: 3 ruling(s) (5651572469, 5716259259, 5729478920)` — the third is hotlong's batch #159 item 2 (「the 2026-09-13 ruling stands」), ruled at 11:42Z after the dev's measurement and read by the tool oldest-first with the two-ruling advice printed: the reader test held on a thread that moved under it. On `main` the same run prints no thread clause at all. `--pair 19021` exit 0; `closingKeywordTargets(body)` = `{18993 → Fixes}`; commit trailers model-free; no model string in the body.

- Gates: 40 derived / 40 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED at `cba931995` (one exit 3 cleared by building formula + lint under the verify lock, re-run 0); `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 779.3 s detached, 1849 cases; `check:pm-half-states` 4963 cases (the H62 writer pin reads this file). ## 维护者速读(终稿)· skills 席 · 2026-09-18T12:03Z

**这个 PR 做什么**:PM 循环在呈报决策卡前要机械查一遍「有没有已经裁过的」。查重工具 `check-prior-rulings.mjs` 以前只读三份树上的语料(ADR、AGENTS.md、spec 源码),**读不到卡自己线程上的维护者裁决** —— #17518 因此被当作未裁重新呈报,您裁了两次、互相矛盾,一整轮派发零 diff 收场。现在工具每次 `--card N` 都把卡的评论线程当第四份语料读一遍,按裁决评论的首行形状识别(总监席的三种写法都认,两种「以 Ruling 开头但不是裁决」的写法明确排除),粘贴行多一段 `thread: k ruling(s) (评论 id)`;读不到线程整行写 `unresolved`,⛔ 不会假装线程是空的。章程 SKILL.md :339 与 decision-analysis.md :45 同批改成对应的字,各一行、净 0。

**代价,实测**:每次查重多一次分页读线程 —— 事故卡 #17518 是 1 页、0.35 秒;板上最长的线程(962 条评论)10 页、4.4 秒。
